title: Structured Retrieval Failure Record
description: Schema for a single structured extraction of an incomplete-memory photo retrieval failure from user feedback.

source.description: The platform this record was collected from.

url.description: Permalink to the original review, post, or comment.

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the original review/post.

raw_text.description: The original user text (may be truncated to 2000 chars).

photo_type.description: The type of photo/video the user was trying to find.

remembered_attributes.description: Attributes the user DOES remember about the photo.

forgotten_attributes.description: Attributes the user CANNOT recall, preventing effective search.

search_strategy_used.description: The search approach the user attempted (or didn't attempt).

failure_point.description: Where in the search process the user's attempt broke down.

outcome.description: The final result of the user's retrieval attempt.

emotional_stakes.description: How emotionally significant the photo is. 'high' = involves loss, health, nostalgia, or milestones.

workaround_used.description: Any workaround the user employed outside of Google Photos search.

query_formulation.description: Captures how the user formulated their search query. Infer 'style' only from explicit search-behavior described in raw_text; do not infer a search attempt if the record only describes the memory or frustration, not an action taken.

style.description: The style of search query the user attempted. Use 'not_mentioned' when raw_text does not describe any explicit search action.

example_query_paraphrased.description: Max 12 words, paraphrased in the model's own words — never a verbatim quote from raw_text. null if style is 'not_mentioned'.

query_matched_forgotten_gap.description: true = query targeted the specific thing they'd forgotten; false = query was unrelated to the forgotten gap, or they gave up; null = style is 'not_mentioned' or 'no_query_browsed_manually'.
